verdict.rationale: Floot documents exporting code and the database to self-host elsewhere, which is a one-way export. It also documents connecting Cursor, VS Code or Zed as MCP clients, but that drives Floot's hosted project through AI tools rather than editing local files. Nothing in the evidence shows a way to push locally edited code back into the Floot platform, such as git sync, file upload or a CLI push, so the round-trip workflow is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can work on the app locally with my own editor and tooling and push changes back to the platform
